newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OCBC says sells Malaysian broking arm.
newsitem.headline: OCBC says sells Malaysian broking arm.

text.p: Singapore's OCBC Bank Ltd said on Monday it has sold its stake in a Malaysian brokerage to TCL Premier Holdings Bhd (TCL) in return for shares in the latter.
An OCBC statement said it and other shareholders of OCBC Securities (Melaka) Sdn Bhd agreed to sell their stakes in the broking firm for 103.82 million ringgit on December 6.
OCBC said its 30 percent stake in the company was sold for 31.15 million ringgit.
Under the agreement, OCBC was paid by the issue of 26.25 million TCL shares at about 1.187 ringgit a share.
OCBC bought another 3.75 million TCL shares at 1.75 ringgit each on Monday, bringing its total stake in TCL to 34.3 percent.
